description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template transformation model for generating catalog URLs within the OFBiz framework. It retrieves request context and constructs URLs based on product and category IDs.

classes.name: OfbizCatalogUrlTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel for dynamically generating catalog URLs based on request parameters.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Extracts a string argument from a Map of template arguments, handling SimpleScalar and GenericObjectModel types.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a custom Writer implementation that processes template output, constructing the catalog URL during the close operation.
